text:
kai: heads-up 11 starting a small sprint to build a single publishable Terraform "quickstart" module families for marketplace partners. intent: lower onboarding friction so ISVs can publish Redwoods-compatible deploys with a few vars.

sarah-partners: +1. Core requirements I'd push: marketplace manifest generation (listing metadata), a sample Helm chart deploy, and a lightweight healthcheck probe that marketplace tests can hit.

raj: agree. propose module outputs: k8s_cluster_id, service_endpoint, marketplace_manifest_path. Also add an optional `enable_private_network` flag to toggle VPC peering / shared-nets. keep defaults public to simplify CI.

maria-docs: I'll draft a publishers.md guide with step-by-step: cloning, terraform init/apply, how to run smoke test, and a checklist for publishing (signing, asset sizes, logo sizes). will include images and a small compatibility table.

kai: minimal security baseline? we should lock down node IAM roles and provide example OIDC mapping for fine-grained service account permissions.

raj: adding `minimal_iam` boolean that creates managed node role with least-privilege policy. example policy snippet in README. also pin provider plugin versions and add `providers.tf` template.

devops-bot: CI template generated: .github/workflows/marketplace-smoke.yml. Suggests matrix: [aws, gcp, azure] x [tf1.5, tf1.6].

kai: for QA: plan light smoke tests (k8s cluster up, nginx deploy, TLS via cert-manager, healthcheck responds). we can use terratest for infra and `kubectl` checks for app health.

maria-docs: question for partnerships/legal: do we have to include a signed SBOM or any provenance metadata for assets in the marketplace?

legal: quick note 0min: SBOM preferred for enterprise listings. also require a contact email in listing metadata and confirmation of third-party dependency licensing. we'll send a short checklist tomorrow.

sarah-partners: logistics: target alpha to 3 trusted partners for validation in 10 business days. can partners preview guide + repo?

kai: timeline:
- raj: module skeleton + providers templates by Tue (2105001800)
- maria-docs: publishers guide draft + example manifests by Thu (2105003600)
- devops-bot / raj: CI + terratest smoke by Fri (2105005400)
- legal/sarah-partners: publish checklist + SBOM guidance by Mon (2105007200)

raj: sample tf snippet I'll start with:```hcl
module "redwood_marketplace_quickstart" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/marketplace-quickstart.git//modules/quickstart"
  cloud_provider = "aws" # aws | gcp | azure
  region = "us-west-2"
  enable_private_network = false
  k8s_version = "1.26"
  minimal_iam = true
}
```

maria-docs: good. i'll show an alternate `enable_private_network = true` example that wires a shared VPC/peering for enterprise customers. and include a short troubleshooting section (common TF errors + quick fixes).

sarah-partners: FYI i'll coordinate partner invites and will include co-marketing options for the preview. keep the module LICENSE permissive (MIT) so partners can fork.

kai: blockers?

legal: none beyond SBOM & dependency/license disclosure. we'll provide a template manifest.

raj: okay starting repo skeleton now. will create `examples/` with small Flask demo + Helm chart.

maria-docs: I'll also add a `telemetry_opt_in` example showing how partners can ping a telemetry endpoint (opt-in) so we can capture usage signals for ops and to smooth marketplace metrics.

kai: perfect. i'll follow up with a release thread for the alpha preview when we have an internal build. thanks all.
